name: task-recovery
description: Recover the result of a timed-out Sonilo generation call using its task_id. Use whenever text_to_sfx, video_to_sfx, video_to_video_music, video_to_video_sfx, video_to_sound, video_to_video_sound, audio_ducking, dubbing, proofread, analyze_video, or video_to_music(preserve_speech=true) times out or its call was interrupted — the generation already ran (and was already charged) and its result is still retrievable.
author: sonilo-ai
